findings.issue: False kanji claim. The pair 真逆 is very commonly read まぎゃく ('exact opposite'); saying it 'is not read まぎゃく' is wrong and misleads the learner. Only in the rare ateji use for まさか does it read まさか.
findings.current: Em 真逆 (まさか) a leitura é irregular: não se lê "まぎゃく".
findings.suggested: Aqui 真逆 é lido まさか (leitura irregular); esses mesmos kanji também se leem まぎゃく, com o sentido de "exatamente o oposto".

findings.issue: Typo in the kana range: the words taught start with ほ (堀, 本人, ぼんやり) and ま, as the description itself says ('começam por ほ e ま'). The title says は.
findings.current: Do fosso ao microfone: o cotidiano em は a ま
findings.suggested: Do fosso ao microfone: o cotidiano em ほ a ま

findings.issue: In running text まさか is written in kana; spelling it 真逆 makes the sentence read as まぎゃく ('exatamente o oposto') and is not natural orthography for an example sentence.
findings.current: 真逆彼が負けるとは思わなかった
findings.suggested: まさか彼が負けるとは思わなかった

findings.issue: The tip claims 真逆 'is not read まぎゃく'. In contemporary Japanese 真逆 is standardly read まぎゃく ('the exact opposite'); the まさか reading of that spelling is a rare ateji. As written the note asserts a false kanji fact and hides the far more common reading.
findings.current: Em 真逆 (まさか) a leitura é irregular: não se lê "まぎゃく".
findings.suggested: Em 真逆 a grafia é ateji para まさか (por isso まさか costuma vir em kana); lido まぎゃく, 真逆 é outra palavra: "exatamente o oposto".

findings.issue: Title says the lesson covers words 'em は a ま', but no word in the lesson starts with は — the description itself states the block covers ほ e ま (堀, 本人, 本物, ぼんやり...). は is a typo for ほ.
findings.current: Do fosso ao microfone: o cotidiano em は a ま
findings.suggested: Do fosso ao microfone: o cotidiano de ほ a ま
